_comment_do_not_ship_verbatim: Example panel only, NOT provisioned (unlike docs/operations/grafana/dashboards/kelvran-overview.json's 3 real, live-verified Prometheus panels) and NOT live-verified against a real Tempo backend -- per docs/upgrade-research/competitor-feature-parity-2026-09-14.md Finding 2's own build_now companion. kelvran.cost.usd/kelvran.savings.usd are deliberately STORED AS STRINGS on the span (attribute.String, never attribute.Float64 -- see ChatCompletionResult.CostUSD's own doc comment: OTel's attribute value model has no decimal type, and converting to float64 would reintroduce the exact precision loss docs/rfcs/2026-09-02-decimal-cost-accounting.md exists to remove). Tempo's TraceQL metrics functions (sum_over_time, etc.) operate on NUMERIC span attributes only, so this panel deliberately uses a TraceQL SEARCH query (raw matching spans, not a metrics aggregation) plus Grafana's own client-side table transformations (convert field type string->number, then group-by kelvran.agent_run_id with a Sum aggregation) to get a per-agent-run breakdown -- verify the exact TraceQL search table column-naming convention against your own configured Tempo/Grafana version before importing this; do not assume these field names are correct for every backend/version.
title: Kelvran Agent-Run Cost & Savings (example)

panels.title: Cost and savings by agent run
panels.description: kelvran.agent_run_id / kelvran.cost.usd / kelvran.savings.usd, all real span attributes (RecordChatCompletionResult, gateway/internal/telemetry/result.go). savings_usd is only ever non-empty on a genuine cache hit -- an agent run with zero cache hits shows a real, present, empty/zero savings figure alongside a real, non-zero cost, never a fabricated $0 for 'never measured'. This is the one place a per-agent-run breakdown is possible at all: kelvran.cache.savings_usd (telemetry.go) is an aggregate-only Prometheus counter dimensioned by cache layer, never by agent_run_id, for the same unbounded-cardinality reason a Prometheus metric label never carries agent_run_id -- Tempo's own per-span storage has no equivalent cardinality-explosion risk, since each span is its own record, never pre-aggregated by label the way Prometheus is.
